overall_notes: The paper presents Asclepius, a comprehensive medical multi-modal LLM evaluation benchmark. It evaluates both generation (report generation, open-ended VQA) and discriminative tasks (multiple-choice, yes/no). The evaluation uses automatic metrics (Accuracy, ROUGE) plus human evaluation by medical specialists and LLM-as-judge for open-ended questions. The extraction was generally good but needed some normalization and clarification of task scope.
